{{Quote|There's the trouble! Imperial Troopers using laser saws to whack their way through the plants!|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="The Kashyyyk Depths">"[[The Kashyyyk Depths]]"</ref>}}
A '''laser saw''' was a device that used lasers to cut through solid objects. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a team of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] used them on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] to cut through the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] dense vegetation.<ref name="The Kashyyyk Depths" />
